description_en: Release an expired Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 释放已经到期的DDoS高防实例
name: ReleaseInstance

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the instance to be released.

> Only expired instances can be released. You can call [DescribeInstances](~~91478~~) to query the IDs and expiration status of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances.
parameters.description_zh:
要释放的实例ID。

> 只允许释放已到期的实例。您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~91478~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID和到期状态信息。
